snippet.title: Synth Riders - Groovin' Essentials DLC | Dec 15 [Release Trailer]
snippet.description:
Buy Synth Riders: https://bit.ly/playsr

Get your funk’n’groove on with Synth Riders and the Groovin’ Essentials Music Pack, featuring Bruno Mars, Silk Sonic and Starcadian in a 24K-lineup of award-winning hits. Five stellar songs with strong roots in disco and funk, make this the perfect soundtrack while you dance ‘til dawn! The new collection will be available from December 15th on Meta Quest, Steam, PlayStation VR and Viveport. 

“Groovin’ Essentials” features five paid DLC songs:
- “24K Magic” - Bruno Mars
- “Runaway Baby” - Bruno Mars
- “Skate” - Silk Sonic (feat. Bruno Mars, Anderson .Paak)
- “Manuals” - Starcadian
- “Supersymmetry” - Starcadian

Available on Meta Quest, Steam Store, PlayStation Store & Viveport from December 15, 2022 at the price of $7.99 for the music pack (20% discount) or $1.99 for individual songs. 

See store page for current pricing and discover more music packs:

Synth Riders on Meta Quest: https://oculus.com/experiences/quest/2436558143118760/
Synth Riders on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/885000/Synth_Riders/
Synth Riders on PSVR: https://store.playstation.com/concept/235392
